notes: Adds a temporary listener to Foundry's official error hook during the ADK DEV LOADER run.
Captures identifier validation errors even when they bypass Item.update and ui.notifications.error.
Records loader phase, Foundry error location, message, notify level, hook data, and stack at globalThis.__FEHA_LAST_FOUNDRY_IDENTIFIER_ERRORS.
Removes the temporary error hook before the loader exits.
No gameplay, balance, catalog, manufacturer, armor, or observer behavior changes are introduced.
